_comment: Copy to security-config.json beside wideband.exe. Replace YOUR_* placeholders with values you are authorized to use. Never commit real OEM masks.
_tacoma_can_checklist: 1) After Identify ECU, note Cal ID (89663-xxxxx) — pick or add a densoGenerations id for that OS.
2) Set densoGenerations[].mask to your authorized Denso32 XOR mask; set that row configured=true.
3) Set profiles.tacoma-can.generation to that id (or inline mask), algorithm denso32, endian big, configured=true only when mask is real.
4) From your XDF/stock ROM: fill checksums[] start/end/store for tacoma-can; set configured=true after bench-validating on a copy.
5) Leave configured=false until intentional — app stays fail-closed for 0x27 flash and checksum stamp.

tacoma-can._profile_note: generation links to densoGenerations[].id; flash uses security-config only — not flash-layout.json
